subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Builds and sounds out 3- and 4-letter words using sounds learnt

show.line: Let's build longer words! l, i, o, n. Lion!

rounds.prompt: Listen. f, r, o, g. What word is it?
Listen. s, n, a, ke. What animal is it?
Break it up! Say the sounds in frog.

hints: Say each sound. Then push them all together.
Point to each letter as you say its sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. c, r, a, b.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! c, r, a, b makes crab. I missed the r.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. c, r, a, b. Crab!

parent_line: Can sound out and read four-letter words like frog, crab and duck.
